analysis.headline: Sells Your Data to Advertisers
analysis.quote: Like many companies, however, we use services that help deliver interest-based ads to you and may transfer Personal Information to business partners for their use. Making Personal Information (such as online identifiers or browsing activity) available to these companies may be considered a “sale” or “sharing” of your Personal Information under the CCPA.

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: We may also use cookies and similar technologies to provide you advertising on third-party sites based upon your browsing activities and interests.

analysis.headline: Aggregates Your Data
analysis.quote: Cloudflare may aggregate data we acquire about our Customers, Administrators, and End Users. For example, we may assemble data to determine how Web crawlers index the Internet and whether they are engaged in malicious activity or to compile web traffic reports and statistics.

analysis.headline: Shares with Partners for Marketing
analysis.quote: Send commercial communications, in accordance with your communication preferences, such as providing you with information about products and services, features, surveys, newsletters, offers, promotions, contests, and events about us and our partners; and send other news or information about us and our partners.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Voice/Image
analysis.quote: When you participate in a Cloudflare study, we may ask for your permission to record your voice and/or image during your participation in the study.

analysis.headline: Discloses to Law Enforcement
analysis.quote: When we are required to disclose personal information to respond to subpoenas, court orders, or legal process, or to establish or exercise our legal rights or defend against legal claims.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: To facilitate our global operations, we may transfer and access such information from around the world, including from other countries in which the Cloudflare Group has operations for the purposes described in this Policy.

analysis.headline: Your Posts Can Be Public
analysis.quote: If you choose to participate in any of these Interactive Areas, please be aware that any information that you post in an Interactive Area might be read, collected, and used by others who access it.

analysis.headline: Not for Under 18
analysis.quote: Cloudflare’s Websites and Services are not intended for, nor designed to attract, individuals under the age of eighteen. Cloudflare does not knowingly collect or share personal information from any person under the age of eighteen.
